protocol: Reuse three frozen original-pool 490-speaker encoders. Fresh paired Transformer initialization and dropout per encoder seed; identical inputs, parameters, initial scores, query/negative schedule, learning rates and 64k budget. CV-only frozen-encoder hard negatives after a 4k uniform prefix. Primary: direct versus weighted; diagnostics: weighted_no_kl versus weighted and direct versus weighted_no_kl. Earliest minimum selection macro EER, final checkpoint secondary. Freeze all selected/final models and selection FAR1% thresholds before test inference. No automatic promotion.
limitations: Previously observed selection/test speakers; exploratory, not a new independent holdout. Three paired acoustic/fusion seeds, not a fully crossed seed study. Direct is a residual score head around the uniform cosine mean, not a raw-waveform model. Weighted-only KL changes with the head; weighted_no_kl isolates this. Equal updates and parameter counts do not imply identical optimization dynamics. A negative result does not establish the information-theoretic limit of phoneme waveforms.
